description: Shared book definitions: identifiers, contributors, publishers, editions, edition references, and result pages.

identifier.description: A global or provider-scoped identifier. Shared provider identifiers may express that provider's grouping of editions.

type.description: Identifier namespace: a well-known global scheme token or a provider domain. Providers may use subdomains to distinguish namespaces. Compare this string exactly. Writers use lowercase global tokens and lowercase ASCII provider domains (IDNA A-labels for internationalized domains), without a scheme, path, or trailing dot.

value.description: Opaque identifier in its namespace's canonical form, defined in the proposal's identifier writing table. For isbn, write hyphenless ISBN-13, converting ISBN-10 on write. Matching compares type and value exactly without parsing or normalization.

url.description: Optional canonical URL within the namespace, for display and reference only; never part of identifier comparison.

contributor.description: Someone who contributed to the work or edition in some capacity.

name.description: The contributor's full known name; no particular order is required.

role.description: Nature of the contribution. If omitted, author is assumed.

identifiers.description: Identifiers denoting this contributor in global or provider namespaces, compared exactly by type and value.

ref.description: Optional enrichment reference. The target record type is deliberately unspecified; resolving it is never required for display.

publisher.description: The organization that published the edition.

identifiers.description: Identifiers denoting this publisher in global or provider namespaces, compared exactly by type and value.

editionRef.description: A self-contained book reference for reviews and other records. Cover fields are optional.

identifiers.description: Known identifiers for this edition, including provider grouping identifiers. Include the writing provider's identifier where available.

contributors.description: Contributors credited on the edition. May be empty for anonymous or unknown contributions.

cover.description: Optional cover image, strongly recommended when storing in a repository. The blob must belong to the repository containing the record, including when embedded in a review. May coexist with coverUrl.

coverUrl.description: Optional cover image URL, useful for API responses and providers without repository storage. May coexist with cover; a URL alone does not preserve image bytes in the user's repository.

edition.description: Full edition metadata for embedding and optional repository publication. Provider APIs use editionView, which carries covers as URLs only.

identifiers.description: Known identifiers for this edition, including provider grouping identifiers. Include the writing provider's identifier where available.

contributors.description: Contributors credited on the edition. May be empty for anonymous or unknown contributions.

cover.description: Optional cover image, strongly recommended when storing in a repository. The blob must belong to the repository containing the record, including when embedded in a review. May coexist with coverUrl.

coverUrl.description: Optional cover image URL, useful for API responses and providers without repository storage. May coexist with cover; a URL alone does not preserve image bytes in the user's repository.

createdAt.description: Time this edition record or snapshot was created, not its publication date.

language.description: Language of the edition as a BCP 47 language tag.

publishedDate.description: Publication date at its known precision: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Preserve available precision without inventing a month or day. Applications must validate the date; this is not a datetime.

format.description: Medium of the edition. Additional values are permitted; clients should provide a fallback for unrecognized formats.

pages.description: Total page count for print or ebook editions, when known.

durationSeconds.description: Total audio duration in whole seconds, when known.

chapters.description: Total chapter count, when known. This is an extent, not the reader's progress or a table of contents.

seriesPosition.description: Position within the series, preserving forms such as 1.5 or Vol. II.

bookEdition.description: Edition statement, such as 2nd revised or Abridged.

editionView.description: Full edition metadata for API responses. Covers are represented only by optional coverUrl; providers omit cover and coverDid. The URL may point to a blob download endpoint.

coverUrl.description: Optional directly retrievable cover image URL. May point to a CDN, image service, or a blob download endpoint including the repository and blob identifiers needed to fetch it. No separate cover or coverDid is supplied.

durationSeconds.description: Total audio duration in whole seconds, when known.

chapters.description: Total chapter count, when known. This is an extent, not the reader's progress or a table of contents.

seriesPosition.description: Position within the series, preserving forms such as 1.5 or Vol. II.

bookEdition.description: Edition statement, such as 2nd revised or Abridged.

editionResults.description: Shared response envelope for search and single-book resolution.

items.description: Full edition views in provider-defined relevance order, with URL-only covers. Preserve known identifiers, including the provider's identifiers; do not reduce them to only those supplied in the request.

hasMore.description: Whether more matching editions remain after this page. Must be false for an empty page.

total.description: Optional total number of matching editions before pagination, not the size of this page. Omit if not known.
